input.quote: The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement allocates control (5.2), merchant-of-record status (5.3) and a Marks licence to HDI (6.1), but never allocates ownership of the Site, the work product HDI develops for us, or the customer, order and user data generated through the Site — HDI both builds and hosts it and bears the cost, so by default it would claim the deliverables and hold our data with no licence back. We inserted a Section 5.5 confirming our ownership of Content, Marks, Site work product (assigned to us) and customer data, with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and granting us a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded HDI materials, and no joint ownership.

input.quote: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated, with a direct Internet connection of shared but greater than T-1 bandwidth
input.rationale: The Section 1.4 grant of access to HDI's system and administration tools runs to "the Company" alone, with no mention of affiliates or contractors, no statement that the right is irrevocable during the term, and no successor transfer. We added the affiliate/contractor scope, irrevocability during the term (subject to our uncured material breach) and transferability to an M&A successor.
